description: PROVE WHAT YOUR OWN RECORD REALLY EARNED: how reliable your service is, how accurate your forecasts are, or what your trading really returned (call with no arguments for the guide to each). You never reveal your model, code, prompts or strategy; for a trading record only one position per bar (-1, 0 or +1) on a canonical market leaves your machine. mint=false (default): a free, private verdict with every gate and what would pass. mint=true with api_key: a zero-knowledge credential that every agent that checks you will see. Call with no arguments for the markets and the exact format.
name: prove
